en: The One Hundred and Eight Names of Mañjuśrī of the Thousand Bowls: Namaḥ sarva-jña-jñāna-dharmatā-svabhāva-śuddha-sarva-dharma-samatā-viśuddha-maṇḍala-samavasaraṇāya mañjuśriye kumāra-bhūtāya | Obeisance to Mañjuśrī, the Youthful, whose nature is the reality of the wisdom of the omniscient one, who is purified by the equality of all phenomena, and who is the convergence of the pure mandala.

Based on the manuscript of Kanken, the *Sōjō* (Chief Abbot) of Hannyaji Temple, this was transcribed by the Vinaya Master Zennin on the nineteenth day of the fifth month in the sixth year of Meishō (the Ding-si year), corresponding to 1317 CE.
